questions.learningObjective: Apply poverty line to a study of poverty line.

stimulus.body: In 2007 officials in West Africa counted 450 retirees and found 65% below the official poverty line, while 33% were just above it.

questions.stem: What is the point gap in the 2007 Africa poverty line survey?
questions.explanation: Subtracting 33 percent from 65 percent gives 32 percentage points, the gap reported in the 2007 data from West Africa between the two shares.
questions.hint: Look past the numbers to the relationship they describe.
